children.title: Limitations
children.summary:
When you use the apply_security_profile_group action with logging enabled, Cloud NGFW
doesn't capture logs of all sessions.

children.title: Logging examples
children.summary: A log entry is generated each time that a firewall rule with logging enabled applies to traffic.
